keys.description: When true, this MCP server checks at startup for the machine's dashboard daemon (one per OS environment, serving local web pages for the workflow sessions on it) and starts it in the background when it is absent or older than this server, and it lists each top-level lead session it serves on the dashboard; when false, it does neither. The startup check reads the value once at server startup, from the project, global, and built-in values only, so a change applies from the next server start. Whether a session is listed is read for that session, a session-scope tune included, and a change applies within a minute: a session whose value is false is never listed, and this server sends the daemon nothing about it. MCP tools behave the same either way, and a daemon that fails to start never fails a tool. When this key's manifest fails to load, the dashboard stays off.

TCP port the dashboard daemon listens on, on the loopback interface; 0 always uses a port the OS assigns. When the port is taken, the daemon falls back to an OS-assigned port and records the port it uses in its endpoint file. Passed to the daemon when an MCP server starts it, so a running daemon keeps its port until it is next started. Read once at server startup; only the project, global, and built-in values apply.
